title.rendered: Upcoming ntop meetings: Nürnberg, Luxembourg, Pisa, Milano.

content.rendered:
Next week is going to be a busy week for us as we’ll (Luca and Alfredo) be make a short tour in Europe to present ntopng and the latest ntop apps.

  • October 23rd,  Open Source Network Conference, Nürnberg, Germany.
  • October 24-25th, Hack.Lu and Suricata Team, Luxembourg City, Luxembourg.
  • October 26th, Linux Day 2013, Pisa, Italy.
  • October 29th, Open Source Conference 2013, Milano, Italy.

We would like to meet ntop users and hear their feedback, criticism and suggestions.

See you next week!
